svg.title: Safe driver and submission recovery
svg.desc: Immutable terminal output wins. Otherwise recovery must prove the driver, app-server and captured descendants ended. Incomplete shutdown retries the recorded identities without signaling an unproved PID. A definitely unsent launch may retry once. A possibly sent turn is looked up by client ID and never resent. Unique completed history is adopted; missing or ambiguous evidence stays uncertain. Steering observations and history can settle acceptance without resending. Batch children require exact digest ownership. Uncertain children are never resent; proof of no live process frees capacity for unaffected planned children, while possible-live children retain their slots.
svg.text: Resolve uncertainty from evidence; never resend a possibly sent prompt
